Vs.

full_judgment: The petitioner Hazera Bibi is a co-sharer of the holdings appertaining to khatian Nos. 165 and 180 of Mouza Majkhandi and Mouza Nazirkha respectively. O.P. No. 3 Abdul Kha Jeque (he was O.P. No. 2 in the pre-emption case) transferred 391/2 sataks of land from both the khatians by registered kabala dated 6.3.72 to O. P. No. 2 Sayed Habibur Rahman (he was O.P. No. 1 in the pre-emption case). By another registered kabala dated the same O.P. No. 3 Abdul Kbaleque transferred another 42 sataks out of Khatian No. 165 to O.P. No.2 Syed Mahibur Rahman. O.P. No. 3 Abdul Khaleque was also a co-sharer of the holdings. O.P. No. 2 Syed Habibur Rahman was a stranger. Ay a kabala dated 26.8.72 O.P No. 2 Syed Habibur Rahman transferred his purchased land hereinafter referred to as the case land to O.P. No. 1 Nurjahan Begum (who was O.P. No. 10 in the pre-emption case). Thereafter on 17.9.73 the petitioner filed an application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for pre-emption of the case land and she deposited the consideration of the two kabalas with statutory compensation. Hazera Bibi owned 5/6 bighas of land.
